clauses.english: burned the house of the LORD and the houses of Jerusalem
clauses.ukr: спалив дім Господній і доми в Єрусалимі
clauses.deu: verbrannte das Haus des HERRN und die Häuser zu Jerusalem
clauses.spa: quemó la casa del SEÑOR y las casas de Jerusalem

clauses.why: The verse says he carried away the remnant of the people left in the city, not all the remnant; the wording is fine but "captive" and Babylon are stated, so only a tighter wording is needed.
clauses.english: carried the remnant of the people captive to Babylon
clauses.deu: führte den Rest des Volkes gefangen gen Babel
clauses.spa: transportó el resto del pueblo a Babilonia

clauses.why: The charge was given by Nebuchadrezzar, and the release from Ramah is in JER 40:1; the sending to fetch Jeremiah in 39:13-14 was done with the princes, so narrow the clause to the release.
